[LCST.4.5.9] **Temporal text.** Each temporal type has one canonical text form,
and the `::String` cast writes it:

| Type | Canonical form |
|---|---|
| `Time` | `"iso8601"` ([LTIM.8.2.1]) |
| `Date` | `"iso8601"` ([LTIM.8.2.1]) |
| `Duration` | the compact form ([LTIM.8.4.1]) |

`t::String`, `d::String` and `dur::String` must render the value in its type's
canonical form. No cast reads one back ([LCST.4.5.2]). Formats other than the
canonical one are the `to_string` member's ([LTIM.8.1.2]).
